facts.fact: Trailer 1 recreated real Florida moments: a woman twerking on top of a car on Miami's MacArthur Causeway, and a trapper pulling a giant alligator out of a swimming pool.
GTA started life in Scotland as 'Race'n'Chase', a DMA Design project in which you could play cops or robbers. DMA Design later became Rockstar North.
Rockstar says Trailer 2 drew more than 475 million views across all platforms in 24 hours, ahead of the 365 million for the Deadpool & Wolverine trailer.
facts.flag: Rockstar's own figure, not independently audited.

facts.fact: According to YouTuber TGG, Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said Vice City alone is twice the size of GTA 5's Los Santos, and the whole map is twice GTA 5's and three times Red Dead Redemption 2's.
facts.flag: One interview (to YouTuber TGG), relayed by Kotaku.

facts.fact: Rockstar told a UK court the 2022 hack cost it about $5 million to recover from, plus thousands of hours of staff time.
Trailer 1 got 90,421,491 YouTube views in its first 24 hours: a Guinness World Record for a video game reveal, and more than MrBeast's record for a non-music video.
Trailer 1 was also the most liked video game trailer on YouTube, with about 8.9 million likes in its first day.
After Trailer 1, Spotify streams of Tom Petty's 'Love Is a Long Road' rose about 37,000% on the week before.
After Trailer 2, Spotify streams of the Pointer Sisters' 'Hot Together' rose by about 182,000% on the same period a week earlier.
Kotaku crossed Leonida from its southern tip to its northern edge: 3 hours 21 minutes on foot, 10 minutes 53 seconds by car on the highways, and 5 minutes 51 seconds by plane.
facts.flag: One outlet's own test.

facts.fact: Rockstar said Trailer 2 was captured entirely in-game on a PlayStation 5, in equal parts gameplay and cutscenes.
Lucia's family comes from Liberty City, GTA's version of New York: she wants the good life her mother has dreamed of since their days there.
Rockstar considered three or even four lead characters before settling on a two-person outlaw pair in the style of Bonnie and Clyde, Kotaku reported.
facts.flag: Reported in Kotaku's round-up of launch-window interviews.

facts.fact: Food and exercise change how your character looks: overeating adds weight and working out builds muscle, a feature GTA San Andreas had before.
facts.flag: Kotaku round-up of previews.

facts.fact: Rockstar avoided very specific modern references so the satire would not date during the game's long development.
facts.flag: Rockstar comment to IGN, relayed by Kotaku.

facts.fact: A banner plane in Trailer 1 advertises a nightclub called Nine1Nine, like Miami's real E11even club.
The boxed copy of GTA 6 has no disc at launch: the box holds a download code.
As of February 2026, Take-Two reported GTA V had sold more than 225 million copies and the Grand Theft Auto series more than 465 million.
facts.flag: Take-Two figures as reported by secondary outlets; later reports put GTA V past 230 million.

facts.fact: A GTA 6 gameplay showing premiered on Netflix on 27 August 2026, before it reached YouTube, captured on a PS5.
facts.flag: Runtime differs by outlet: about 26 minutes (Kotaku) or just over 30 (VGC).

facts.fact: Lucia is the first woman lead of a mainline GTA since the series went 3D with GTA III; the 1997 original let you pick female characters.
The first Vice City game (2002) was set in 1986 and starred Tommy Vercetti. GTA 6 brings Vice City into the modern day.
facts.flag: Older-game facts from Wikipedia.

facts.fact: The first trailer leaked online, so Rockstar posted it a day early, on 4 December 2023, instead of its planned 5 December premiere.
In November 2023, Sam Houser announced the first trailer for early December, the month of Rockstar's 25th anniversary.
Rockstar first confirmed the next GTA was 'well underway' in February 2022, tucked inside a Newswire post about GTA V on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Cal Hampton, Jason's paranoid friend, feels safest at home with a few beers, snooping on Coast Guard communications.
Brian Heder, an old-school Keys smuggler, runs a boat yard with his third wife, Lori, and lets Jason live rent-free in return for help with shakedowns.
The Real Dimez are Bae-Luxe and Roxy, high-school friends turned rap duo; an early hit with local rapper DWNPLY lifted them, and they are now signed to Only Raw Records.
Boobie Ike turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio, and co-runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest.
In Ambrosia, the Allied Crystal sugar refinery provides the jobs and the local biker gang provides almost everything else.
Mount Kalaga National Park offers hunting, fishing and off-road trails, and its backwoods are home to hillbilly mystics and paranoid radicals.
Trailer 1 recreated real Ocean Drive hotels such as the Breakwater, the Beacon and the Avalon.
The six-star Wanted level returns, one more star than GTA 5's five.
Police remember what you look like and what car you are driving, and swapping masks, hats or clothes before a crime lowers your Wanted level.
Previews in August 2026 said you can pet dogs and buy them treats.
An in-game phone app called Waink scans a car to show whether it is locked, has an alarm or tracker, and what it is worth.
In August 2026, Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told a YouTuber there would be no dedicated first-person mode at launch; first-person view is limited to certain weapons.
facts.flag: Confirmed to one Brazilian YouTuber, relayed by Kotaku.

facts.fact: Jason and Lucia start out as a couple, but Rockstar said in August 2026 the romance is optional: the pair stay partners in crime either way.
facts.flag: Rockstar to IGN, relayed by Kotaku.

facts.fact: Rob Nelson said his own playthrough took about 80 hours; VGC's reviewer put the main story at about 60 hours without side content.
In August 2026, Take-Two's CEO said pre-orders were skewing towards the $99.99 Ultimate Edition over the $79.99 Standard Edition.
Sony and Microsoft each said GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game in the history of their own digital stores.
facts.flag: Each claim covers one store only; no combined count was published.

facts.fact: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB of free space, and pre-loading opened on 10 November 2026.
The worldwide launch rolled out at midnight local time, country by country, and started in New Zealand at 12:00 AM NZDT on 19 November 2026.
Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said the single-player game has no microtransactions and that no generative AI was used to make it.
facts.flag: Covers the story mode only; plans for any online mode were not discussed.

facts.fact: GTA 6 was first set for 2025, then delayed on 2 May 2025 to 26 May 2026, then delayed again in November 2025 to 19 November 2026.
Trailer 2 arrived on 6 May 2025, four days after Rockstar announced the first delay.
On YouTube alone, Trailer 2 drew about 75.9 million views in its first day by TweakTown's count, below Trailer 1's 24-hour record of 90.4 million.
facts.flag: Single outlet's count.

facts.fact: Lucia was taught to fight by her father, and served time in Leonida Penitentiary for fighting for her family.
Jason grew up around grifters and crooks and served in the Army before ending up in the Keys working for local drug runners.
Raul Bautista is a charming, seasoned bank robber who recruits people willing to take big risks.
Grassrivers, Leonida's wetlands, is best known for its gators, and the August 2026 Extended Look showed players crossing Everglades-style swamp by fan boat.
Rockstar's Vice City includes pastel art deco hotels, the panaderias (bakeries) of Little Cuba, the Tisha-Wocka flea market and a port billed as the cruise ship capital of the world.
Robberies can be split between the two leads: one robs the store while the other drives the getaway car.
On the map, the area police are searching shows as a circle rather than as individual police markers.
GTA 6 costs $79.99 (Standard) or $99.99 (Ultimate) in the US, and £69.99 or £89.99 in the UK.

Weird Al Yankovic is one of the two hosts of Vice City FM, the station for 1980s hits. On 18 November 2026, Kotaku said that as far as it could tell, none of his own songs or parodies are on the radio.
facts.pairs_with: cruising Vice City with the radio on

facts.fact: Rockstar's October 2026 radio reveal cast Bad Bunny as El Martillo, a DJ on the Latin station Cocoteo FM. On Back Country Radio, Lana Del Rey plays Delta Dawne alongside Morgan Wallen.
facts.pairs_with: driving with the radio on, highways

facts.fact: Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya host GTA 6's metal station, The Chamber 106.6, as DJ Kerry and DJ Tom. Slayer's 'Raining Blood' is on the playlist.
Flash FM, billed as the Vice City institution for pop music, is hosted by Robyn. Rappers Trick Daddy and Trina host Dirty South Classics, a station for regional rap and hip-hop classics.
GTA 6 adds on-demand podcasts. Rockstar announced in October 2026 that both radio and podcasts also play through headphones or earbuds connected to the character's phone, not just in vehicles.
facts.pairs_with: walking or jogging on the beach

facts.fact: The French duo Justice composed GTA 6's score: about three hours across 50 digital tracks. Separately, 'Flower in a Hurricane' from GTA VI: The Album features Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard.
Game Informer reported in September 2026 that Leonida has more than 170 animal species, including invasive ones: green iguanas, cane toads, feral cats and even rhesus macaque monkeys.
According to Game Informer, some of Leonida's animals are labelled Rare, Discoverable or Legendary, and Rockstar kept the identities of the hardest-to-find creatures secret.

Leonida's seas hold several kinds of shark, plus whales, rays, turtles and jellyfish, Game Informer's cover story reported. Rockstar also built new fur systems so animal coats get wet, dirty and matted.
Game Informer's September 2026 cover story said Leonida gets tropical storms and seasonal hurricanes. Storms are local too: you can stand in sunshine and watch rain pouring down in the distance.
facts.pairs_with: storms, rain, driving on the coast

facts.fact: Rain leaves puddles that stay on the ground after a storm, and in the right light you can spot a rainbow after a fresh shower, Game Informer reported.

Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told Edge magazine that GTA 6's pedestrians have more than 600,000 animations, plus personality traits that decide how aggressive they are and whether they go for a weapon.
Rockstar brought in more than 50 real street artists to design the murals in Vice City's Stockyard, a district modelled on Miami's Wynwood, Shacknews reported in August 2026, citing Dazed.
The Kaseya Center, home of the Miami Heat, appears in GTA 6 as the Sahara Arena.
GTA 6 has a Metascore of 99, tying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Metacritic's highest score ever.
Spanish magazine HobbyConsolas gave GTA 6 100 out of 100, the first perfect score in its 35-year history.
Wccftech's review counted 121 bars, 287 bus stops, 57 gas stations, 24 Ammu-Nations and 167 ATMs you can tow away across Leonida.
Wccftech's review counted 13 stunt jumps, two golf courses, eight drone time trials and off-road races at a place called the Thrillbilly Mud Club.
You can carry only two main firearms and two sidearms at a time, according to Wikipedia's summary of the game, a change from earlier GTAs.
Some cars must be broken into with a 'Slim Jim' minigame. Engadget reported in August 2026, citing Rob Nelson, that fancier cars with electronic locks need a key cloner before you can steal them.
Small good deeds help your Criminal Profile: previews of the August 2026 Extended Look noted that throwing rubbish into a bin or feeding animals can improve it.
VGC's review says your Criminal Profile can sink to 'Irredeemable', and once you hit it, it is permanent. Crimes in the open world count for more than those in missions.
VGC's reviewer ran into drag queens flirting with police after a traffic stop, and streamers filming themselves jumping off a bridge.
TechRadar's review notes an Uber-style app called RydeMe for booking rides, and a scooter service that delivers your car to you.
GTA 6 is the first mainline GTA story written without Dan Houser since the 1997 original. He left Rockstar in 2020.
Rockstar's staff reportedly almost doubled during development, from 2,441 to 4,711 people across 12 offices, and a Los Angeles branch worked almost solely on making its pedestrians more realistic.
Stay awake for days on end and it shows on your character's face, according to Wikipedia's summary of the game.
In the August 2026 Extended Look, Brian Heder offers Jason and Lucia a job at the Effluvia rooftop bar in downtown Vice City, and Jason drinks Pißwasser, the series' long-running parody lager.
A crime only reaches the police if someone witnesses it or an alarm goes off, Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told IGN. Just committing a robbery doesn't necessarily raise your Wanted level.
facts.flag: Nelson's words to IGN, relayed by Engadget and Vice (IGN itself could not be fetched).
facts.quote: Engadget: "requires that someone witness the crime, or an alarm needs to be set off for it to be reported to the law" (Rob Nelson, quoted by IGN). "Just committing a robbery doesn't necessarily mean your Wanted level will rise, either." Vice: "A crime can go unreported if nobody sees it."

facts.fact: Hollow (outlined) stars mean police are responding to a report but don't know who did it. Solid white stars mean they can see you.
facts.quote: Screen Rant: "White outlined stars: The cops are responding to a report, but don't know you committed the crime." "White stars: The cops can see you and are in active pursuit." Game Rant (hollowed-out stars): "Police have received a report about a crime but don't know who committed it." Engadget (citing GameSpot): "When police have direct line of sight with you, your stars are solid white"

facts.fact: Grey stars mean the cops have lost sight of you but are still searching. Game Rant calls it a good moment to change your clothes, vehicle or appearance before they spot you again.
facts.flag: Close to the bank's clothes-swap fact (gta6-35); the new part is the grey-star timing.
facts.quote: Game Rant (Gray): "Police have lost visual contact but are still searching for you." "This is a good opportunity to change your clothes, vehicle, or appearance before they spot you again." Screen Rant: "Gray stars: The cops can't see you."

facts.fact: Police no longer show up on the minimap. To see them, you have to use the Focus mechanic.
facts.flag: The Focus part is from Push Square only; Engadget (citing GameSpot) confirms police are off the minimap.
facts.quote: Push Square: "Rockstar has done away with showing cops on the minimap; now, you have to use the Focus mechanic to see them." Engadget (citing GameSpot): "you won't be able to see the police on your minimap, which makes it harder to plan escape routes in advance"

facts.fact: To end a pursuit you must get out of the search circle and stay out until it disappears. Even after you escape, your Wanted level stays the same in that area, and if cops recognise you there the chase restarts.
facts.flag: Builds on the bank's search-circle fact (gta6-55); the new part is staying out and the restart rule.
facts.quote: Screen Rant: "To end the pursuit, you'll need to get out of this circle and stay out of it until it disappears" Dexerto: "Even if you've escaped, your Wanted Level will stay the same in this area" "if the cops recognize you, the pursuit will restart." Vice: "Leaving that area is one way to end the immediate pursuit."

facts.fact: A two-heads Heat icon means police know two people did the crime and are hunting both. The fix is to split up: hold Right on the d-pad and press Triangle to Split Up.
facts.flag: Button prompt is the PlayStation layout given by Push Square.
facts.quote: Game Rant (Accomplice): "Police know that two people were involved in the crime and are searching for both characters." "You should look to split up." Push Square: "(This can be particularly important when you're Wanted and police know you're operating as a pair.)" "The easiest way to do this is to hold Right and press Triangle to Split Up" Screen Rant: "Two heads: Partner recognized."

facts.fact: A camera Heat icon means CCTV recorded your crime: smash the security recorder at the scene and the icon clears. But if the camera icon has a cloud, the footage is already online and there's no way to get rid of it.
facts.flag: Smash-to-clear is from Game Rant; the cloud icon is from Screen Rant. Game Rant's bank guide also says cloud-saved CCTV means police are under a minute away.
facts.quote: Game Rant: "Look for the security recorder in the area where you committed the crime." "Smashing or destroying the recorder removes the footage and clears the icon." Screen Rant: "Camera with cloud: You've been caught on camera, and the footage has been uploaded online." "Unfortunately, there's no way to get rid of this icon."

facts.fact: If the car Heat icon shows, police know your getaway vehicle. Switch cars, or once you've lost the immediate chase, get it resprayed at a Pay 'n' Spray or a Mod Shop.
facts.quote: Game Rant: "Police have identified your getaway vehicle, including its appearance and other identifying details." "Abandon the vehicle and steal another one." "Visit a Pay 'N Spray to respray your car after losing the immediate police chase." Screen Rant: "Car: Vehicle recognized. Switch to a different car, or take your current one to a Mod Shop to repaint it."

facts.fact: A one-star Wanted level can be erased by talking the cop down: hold the left trigger to focus on the officer and pick the option to defuse, as long as you don't have a gun out.
facts.flag: Single source (Kotaku launch tips).
facts.quote: "a one-star wanted level can be erased if you just talk to the cop and defuse the situation" "Hold the left trigger to focus on the cop" "you'll see the option to defuse or provoke the cop."

facts.fact: At one star you might only have a patrol car with two officers after you. Two stars bring more police vehicles, and three stars can bring in a helicopter.
facts.flag: Single source for the per-star breakdown; Screen Rant only says more squad cars, SWAT teams and helicopters come as stars rise.
facts.quote: "At one star, you might only have a patrol car with two officers looking for you." "Two stars bring even more police vehicles, while three stars can bring in a whole helicopter."

facts.fact: Get busted and the cops take all the cash in your pocket, and you can't get it back. Money in the bank or in your hidden stash stays safe.
facts.flag: Vice (citing Famitsu) confirms carried cash can be lost on Busted or Wasted; the bank and stash part is Game Rant only.
facts.quote: Game Rant: "Any money you have in your pocket at the time of arrest will be taken by the cops." "You cannot get it back." "Money in the bank or in your hidden stash remains safe." Vice: "cash you're carrying can be lost if you get Busted or Wasted."

facts.fact: Later in the story, getting busted also charges a small bailout fee to your BuckMe account when you're released.
facts.flag: Both pages are Game Rant.
facts.quote: "Starting from Chapter 2, if you get arrested, you're charged a small bailout fee directly to your BuckMe account" "when you're released." "There is no such thing in Chapter 1." Second Game Rant page: "they can (and will) deduct a bail fee from the cash in your Current Account."

facts.fact: Surrender to the police and your Wanted level won't go up and your Criminal Profile stays the same. Resist arrest and get away, and you gain a star and the chase starts again.
facts.flag: Single source (Game Rant).
facts.quote: "If you surrender, your wanted star level will not go up, and you'll immediately be arrested and sent to jail." "Your criminal profile will remain the same." "If you resist arrest (and succeed), your wanted level will go up by 1 star, and the police chase will begin anew."

facts.fact: Each character can carry up to two stash bags, but the second one ties up a hand and limits weapon use. Hold right on the d-pad to hand one to your partner.
facts.quote: Shacknews: "Each of them can carry up to two bags, but this will limit weapon use" "since one of their hands will be used to carry the second bag" "you can hand one of your two bags over to your partner by holding the right d-pad" Game Rant: "Grab all the Marked Bills, and if your bags ever get full, pass them to your partner."

facts.fact: Get busted while carrying stolen goods and the police confiscate them, stash bags meant for a fence included.
facts.flag: Shacknews is softer: if captured or wasted 'you'll probably lose it'.
facts.quote: Game Rant: "If you have any stolen merchandise on your person or in your car, it will be confiscated by the police." "This includes Stash Bags that need to be delivered to fences." Shacknews: "if you're captured or wasted, you'll probably lose it."

facts.fact: Some stolen cars carry an Advanced tracker, shown as a red icon in the bottom left. It only gives away your location if you drive slowly, so keep your speed up or police will swarm the area.
facts.quote: Shacknews: "These trackers do transmit your location, but only if you're moving slowly." "Driving fast will prevent the tracker from transmitting your location." "If you must slow down, which is common, the tracker will tell police where you are, and they will swarm the area." Kotaku: "If you steal a car and you spot a red tracking icon in the bottom left" "police will be able to find you on the map if you drive slowly for too long."

facts.fact: Large banks have three places to loot: the cash drawers, the safe and the vault, which holds the most money. VGC says the police response is huge once they're called.
facts.quote: VGC: "There are basic cash drawers which you can get by threatening the tellers, there are safe which hide large numbers of marked bills" "there are the bank vaults which house the largest amounts of money and in the game." "The police response is huge as soon as they are called" Game Rant: "Large Banks in GTA 6 have three points of interest: The Safe, Vault, and Cash Drawers."

facts.fact: Later in the story, tail an armoured truck to a bank and the vault will be open. But the moment you step into the vault, the alarms go off.
facts.flag: Single source (Game Rant). The same guide says full bank looting unlocks partway through the story; that detail is left out to avoid naming missions.
facts.quote: "If you've tailed an Armored Truck to a bank, then the vault will be open." "As soon as you enter the vault, alarms will go off, so stealth is out the window."

facts.fact: When you sneak in to rob a place, use Focus: doors wired to the alarm system glow red.
facts.flag: Single source (Kotaku launch tips).
facts.quote: "When sneaking into a place to rob it, use focus to spot which doors are connected to the alarm system quickly." "These doors will glow red."

facts.fact: Once free switching unlocks, you can swap control between Jason and Lucia instantly while they are together, and you can swap between them mid-mission.
facts.flag: Free switching in the open world only unlocks after Chapter 1 (Kotaku, VGC guide).
facts.quote: Push Square: "While Jason and Lucia are together, you're able to switch control between them instantaneously." VGC review: "You can swap between them mid-mission, or play the entire thing as one of the other."
